"""Hand written scenarios verified directly against the specification text."""
import json, os, subprocess, sys, tempfile
SUB="/app/submission/main.py"; PY=sys.executable

CFG = {
    "version": 1, "idle_timeout": 10, "packet_limit": 3, "prefix_width": 2,
    "rules": [
        {"id": 7, "class": 2, "priority": 10, "ranges": [[100, 105], [-60, -60]]},
        {"id": 5, "class": 4, "priority": 10, "ranges": [[100, 105], [-60, -60]]},
        {"id": 9, "class": 6, "priority": 99, "ranges": [[7, 7]]},
    ],
    "fallback": {"feature": 0, "threshold": 0, "le": {"class": 8}, "gt": {"class": 9}},
}

fails = []
def check(name, got, exp):
    if got != exp:
        fails.append(name)
        print("FAIL", name)
        print("  got", json.dumps(got))
        print("  exp", json.dumps(exp))

def run(reqs):
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
        p = subprocess.run([PY, "-I", SUB, "compile"], input=json.dumps(CFG).encode(),
                           stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE)
        assert p.returncode == 0, p.stderr.decode()
        path = os.path.join(tmp, "p.json"); open(path, "wb").write(p.stdout)
        data = ("\n".join(json.dumps(r) for r in reqs) + "\n").encode()
        p2 = subprocess.run([PY, "-I", SUB, "stream", path], input=data,
                            stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE)
        assert p2.returncode == 0, p2.stderr.decode()
        return [json.loads(x) for x in p2.stdout.decode().splitlines()]

# A: empty flow closed -> "end" decision from W zeros (feature0 = 0 <= 0 -> class 8)
out = run([{"op": "open", "flow": 1, "time": 0}, {"op": "close", "flow": 1, "time": 0}])
check("A", out, [
  {"events": []},
  {"events": [
     {"type": "decision", "flow": 1, "class": 8, "reason": "end", "at": 0, "time": 0, "rule": None},
     {"type": "closed", "flow": 1, "packets": 0, "matches": 0, "class": 8, "reason": "end", "rule": None}]},
])

# B: key hit at packet 3 (rules 7 and 5 have equal priority and length -> smallest id 5 wins)
out = run([{"op": "open", "flow": 1, "time": 0},
           {"op": "chunk", "packets": [
               {"flow": 1, "time": 1, "source": 0, "length": 102},
               {"flow": 1, "time": 2, "source": 1, "length": 60},
               {"flow": 1, "time": 3, "source": 0, "length": 101}]}])
check("B", out[1], {"events": [
   {"type": "match", "flow": 1, "rule": 5, "start": 0, "end": 2},
   {"type": "match", "flow": 1, "rule": 7, "start": 0, "end": 2},
   {"type": "decision", "flow": 1, "class": 4, "reason": "key", "at": 2, "time": 2, "rule": 5}]})

# C: packet limit reached with no match -> packet_limit decision
out = run([{"op": "open", "flow": 1, "time": 0},
           {"op": "chunk", "packets": [
               {"flow": 1, "time": 1, "source": 0, "length": 11},
               {"flow": 1, "time": 2, "source": 0, "length": 12},
               {"flow": 1, "time": 3, "source": 0, "length": 13}]}])
check("C", out[1], {"events": [
   {"type": "decision", "flow": 1, "class": 8, "reason": "packet_limit", "at": 3, "time": 3, "rule": None}]})

# D: key hit exactly on the packet limit packet -> key wins
out = run([{"op": "open", "flow": 1, "time": 0},
           {"op": "chunk", "packets": [
               {"flow": 1, "time": 1, "source": 0, "length": 11},
               {"flow": 1, "time": 2, "source": 0, "length": 12},
               {"flow": 1, "time": 3, "source": 0, "length": 7}]}])
check("D", out[1], {"events": [
   {"type": "match", "flow": 1, "rule": 9, "start": 2, "end": 3},
   {"type": "decision", "flow": 1, "class": 6, "reason": "key", "at": 3, "time": 3, "rule": 9}]})

# E: idle expiry before a packet; at is the count before that packet
out = run([{"op": "open", "flow": 1, "time": 0},
           {"op": "chunk", "packets": [
               {"flow": 1, "time": 1, "source": 0, "length": 11},
               {"flow": 1, "time": 20, "source": 0, "length": 12}]}])
check("E", out[1], {"events": [
   {"type": "decision", "flow": 1, "class": 8, "reason": "idle", "at": 1, "time": 20, "rule": None}]})

# F: after an idle decision matches are still audited and the closed record repeats it
out = run([{"op": "open", "flow": 1, "time": 0},
           {"op": "chunk", "packets": [
               {"flow": 1, "time": 1, "source": 0, "length": 11},
               {"flow": 1, "time": 20, "source": 0, "length": 102},
               {"flow": 1, "time": 21, "source": 1, "length": 60}]},
           {"op": "close", "flow": 1, "time": 22}])
check("F", out[1], {"events": [
   {"type": "decision", "flow": 1, "class": 8, "reason": "idle", "at": 1, "time": 20, "rule": None},
   {"type": "match", "flow": 1, "rule": 5, "start": 1, "end": 3},
   {"type": "match", "flow": 1, "rule": 7, "start": 1, "end": 3}]})
check("F-close", out[2], {"events": [
   {"type": "closed", "flow": 1, "packets": 3, "matches": 2, "class": 8, "reason": "idle", "rule": None}]})

# G: idle expiry of several flows is reported in ascending flow id order
out = run([{"op": "open", "flow": 9, "time": 0},
           {"op": "open", "flow": 3, "time": 0},
           {"op": "open", "flow": 5, "time": 0},
           {"op": "tick", "time": 100}])
check("G", out[3], {"events": [
   {"type": "decision", "flow": 3, "class": 8, "reason": "idle", "at": 0, "time": 100, "rule": None},
   {"type": "decision", "flow": 5, "class": 8, "reason": "idle", "at": 0, "time": 100, "rule": None},
   {"type": "decision", "flow": 9, "class": 8, "reason": "idle", "at": 0, "time": 100, "rule": None}]})

# H: exactly reaching the timeout does nothing
out = run([{"op": "open", "flow": 1, "time": 0}, {"op": "tick", "time": 10}])
check("H", out[1], {"events": []})

# I: fallback uses the first W features, not the tail
#    flow 1: first feature 5 (>0 -> class 9), later features differ
out = run([{"op": "open", "flow": 1, "time": 0},
           {"op": "chunk", "packets": [
               {"flow": 1, "time": 1, "source": 0, "length": 5},
               {"flow": 1, "time": 2, "source": 0, "length": 1}]},
           {"op": "close", "flow": 1, "time": 3}])
check("I", out[2], {"events": [
   {"type": "decision", "flow": 1, "class": 9, "reason": "end", "at": 2, "time": 3, "rule": None}]})

# J: closed flow can be reopened with fresh state
out = run([{"op": "open", "flow": 1, "time": 0},
           {"op": "chunk", "packets": [{"flow": 1, "time": 1, "source": 0, "length": 102}]},
           {"op": "close", "flow": 1, "time": 2},
           {"op": "open", "flow": 1, "time": 3},
           {"op": "close", "flow": 1, "time": 4}])
check("J", out[1], {"events": []})
check("J2", out[2], {"events": [
   {"type": "closed", "flow": 1, "packets": 1, "matches": 0, "class": 8, "reason": "end", "rule": None}]})
check("J3", out[4], {"events": [
   {"type": "decision", "flow": 1, "class": 8, "reason": "end", "at": 0, "time": 4, "rule": None},
   {"type": "closed", "flow": 1, "packets": 0, "matches": 0, "class": 8, "reason": "end", "rule": None}]})

# K: suffix match of a longer rule (rule 9 has length 1 -> matches every 7)
out = run([{"op": "open", "flow": 1, "time": 0},
           {"op": "chunk", "packets": [
               {"flow": 1, "time": 1, "source": 0, "length": 7},
               {"flow": 1, "time": 2, "source": 0, "length": 7}]},
           {"op": "close", "flow": 1, "time": 3}])
check("K", out[1], {"events": [
   {"type": "match", "flow": 1, "rule": 9, "start": 0, "end": 1},
   {"type": "decision", "flow": 1, "class": 6, "reason": "key", "at": 1, "time": 1, "rule": 9}]})

print("failures:", len(fails))
sys.exit(1 if fails else 0)
PYEOF
cd /app/tmp/work && timeout 300 python3 scenarios.py
